Leadership Musings (366)

        Wake up Blackman
You have to understand the world
If you do understand the world
                                          T E L L
#WomenParticipate
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman's Woes (369) In any community on the planet the blackman is at the bottom of the socioeconomic ladder  In UK you have the English Welsh Irish India Pakistan and the black It does not matter whether the blackman comes from Caribbean Brazil Cuba or Africa
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (371)The blackman does not understand the world  He is a compulsive spender  He buys anything from a kite to a private jet hire a caucasian pilot and fly aimlessly around the world  When it comes to squandering money the blackman is no1
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (372) The blackman does not understand the world  The blackman in his private life or in government does not believe in saving for a rainy day It is all- in -all- out affairs and borrowing money to exist is his way of living
#BlackLivesMatter

(373) In politics perception is everything and assumes a picture larger than life  If you are perceived to be a corrupt politician it is hard if not impossible to change the narrative Once a sunray always a sunray no need for proof or alibi
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes( 374) The blackman does not understand the world He will steal his country's money and lodge it in his erstwhile colonial master banks abroad Later he will borrow the same money and pay high interest on it
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (376) The blackman does not understand the world He is surrounded by abundant natural resources he does not know how to create and build wealth All of a sudden he can become a billionaire by corrupt enrichment
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (378) The blackman does not understand the world  With abundant sunshine the blackman should be at the forefront of supplying solar energy to the whole world  Instead he relied on the old ways of doing things and put solar energy at bay
#BlackLivesMatter

(379) "A true leader sees the big picture (the masses) as against his immediate family so he is naturally selfless never to seek his own but always seek the greatest good for the greatest number of people"
      Nat Adewole The Rabbi
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (380) The blackman does not understand the world  With flora and fauna of tropics he should make his abode the first destination of choice for tourists around the world  Nature has provided him the best clime under the sun
#BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Musings (381)
     "A true leader shows empathy naturally sees the interconnected of humanity in sorrow or joy lamentation or celebration pains or comfort frustration or jubilation"
       Nat Adewale The Rabbi
  #BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Musings (383) 
   "It is impossible to lift Nigeria out of poverty by paying 'poverty wages' to government workers"
        Prof Kingsley Moghalu
#Blacklivesmatter

Blackman Woes (384) The blackman does not understand the world  If you provide him with a gun to protect the citizens he uses the gun to intimidate and kill his fellow blackman without a just cause
#Blacklivesmatter

Leadership Musings (385) The Nigeria government cannot pay its citizens a minimum wage of N30000 per month How much does it cost the Nigeria government to maintain a police dog and an army horse per month ?
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (386) The blackman does not understand the world  He believes that corrupt practices and nepotism are the gains of leadership and therefore cannot render selfless services to his community and country
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (388) The blackman does not understand the world  Time there was when he was shipped abroad as a slave  Now he migrates to Europe in rickety boats and perish on the high seas
#BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Musings (389) "Owo Abu ni nwon fi nse Abu ni alejo" Corrupt politicians steal government money to entertain the locals and buy back influence and votes from them Even some educated Nigerians subscribe to the idea of such corrupt influence
#BlackLivesMatter

(388A) Congratulations to all involved in moving the minimum wage from N18000 to N30000 This is a positive step in poverty reduction in Nigeria
#BlackLivesMatter

Fighting Corruption (391) In many countries presidents and prime-ministers found guilty of corruption are sent to jail  In Nigeria since 1999 no president has been sent to jail  Is it that Nigeria presidents are not corrupt ? 
#BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Education (392)  The blackman does not understand the world  When he is given all the training and education as his fellow caucasian he behaves like "a confused beetle" not knowing what to do with his wealth of knowledge
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (394)The blackman does not understand the world His main preoccupation is to increase the world population unnecessarily without thinking of how the increased population will be fed clothed and educated in preparation for life
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (396) The blackman does not understand the world  All the time he complains about leadership failure whereas the quality of followership in terms of education plays a pivotal role in leadership dynamics
#BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Musings (397) "Ohun ti a ni la ngbe laruge" Nigeria should develop her agriculture  All other things will be added once there is a breakthrough in Nigeria's agricultural development  Nigeria can develop without oil !
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (398) The blackman does not understand the world  His environment is filthy and he harbours the most outrageous and dangerous diseases on earth such as HIV/AIDS and Ebola
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman Woes (400)The blackman does not understand the world When the caucasians drill oil-wells for him in his backyard he and his kinsmen fight dirty for resource control all the days of their lives
#BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Reality (401)  In Nigeria retirement does not bring happiness since most retirees suffer deprivation and poverty in silence Most retirees were simply not prepared or ill-prepared for retirement
#BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Musings (403)
In Nigeria workers receive starvation wages out of which they make distress savings for raining days for survival
#BlackLivesMatter

Political Leaders (405)
Nigerian politicians don't govern
                           they RULE over
                           their citizens
#BlackLivesMatter

Leadership Retirement (407) If you are a retired senior civil servant with poor pension entitlement unpaid regularly with five graduate children with only two of them gainfully employed then you will appreciate what it means to be thrown into extreme poverty
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman's Woes (410)The blackman does not understand the world  He takes pride in importing of virtually everything under the sun including second hand clothings and food items  A country that cannot feed his citizens is not worthy to be called a nation
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman's Woes (412)The blackman does not understand the world  He is greedy ignorant and selfish to the core  Selfishness is ingrained in his DNA  He does not understand the spirit of the TEAM work --Together Each Achieves More
#WomenParticipate
#BlackLivesMatter

Blackman's Woes (414) The blackman does not understand the world  No one will develop the blackman's territory except the blackman
#BlackLivesMatter 
#getinvolved

Blackman's Woes (418) The blackman does not understand the world  Instead of using religions to uplift the masses he uses religions as a weapon to supplant moral decadence and bigotry in schools
#BlackLivesMatter
